RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

An all-female panel is not evidence of anything on its own. In healthcare and biomedical fields, women hold the majority of senior laboratory and HR roles, so a four-woman panel is statistically unremarkable. Raising it as your opening complaint makes you look aggrieved rather than competitive, and it will cost you credibility for any stronger point.

Your real issue is the unanswered request. Follow up formally in writing, citing the date of your original request, and ask specifically which criteria she met more strongly. "Broad leadership experience" versus your eight years running a section and a PhD is a substantive mismatch worth probing.

If the written reasons turn out vague or shifting, reassess then — with facts, not panel composition.
